statement: For every r>=3, each nonempty intrinsic lower-central lifting fiber Q_r to Q_(r-1), modulo geometric conjugacy, is a torsor under the explicit finite matrix cokernel (Lie_r(A_tau)-1)(1+Lie_r(C_V)). All central cocycles are unramified outside3, including above ramified lower sections, and all twisted stabilizers vanish. At r=3 the fiber group is Z3^166 plus (Z/3)^7, (Z/9)^56, (Z/27)^25 and (Z/81)^3. General free-rank and proven torsion-exponent formulas make every degree a finite Hall-matrix calculation.
notes: The integral graded commutator isomorphism is opened Koch-Kukkuk-Labute Theorem2.1; no class-three BCH with denominator3 is used. The Hall basis has330 elements and exact integer action matrices. The saved invertible modular transformations certify Smith valuations0^73,1^7,2^56,3^25,4^3 with166 zero factors modulo729. The split-lattice identity and Frobenius at the K-prime2 prove that all invariant torsion is killed by3^5, so the finite certificate is exact. An independent stacked-invariant calculation agrees. Twisting by a lower section acts trivially on the central graded layer; the first nonzero graded coordinate excludes stabilizers. Actual maps from N/Ndoubleprime and the single-cusp marked quotient to Q3 include their exact kernels. This evaluates every nonempty higher fiber, not the uncomputed higher obstruction image.
